name: @heroesofcrypto/core
description: Core game logic for Heroes of Crypto

scripts.build: rimraf .parcel-cache && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:images && rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js production
scripts.build:docs: rimraf ../../.parcel-cache && rimraf ../../docs/dist && dotenv -e .env.production parcel build --no-optimize src/ui/index.html --public-url . --no-source-maps && cpy dist ../../docs
scripts.build:images: bun scripts/require_asset_location.ts images && bun scripts/require_asset_location.ts animations && bun run check:image-assets && rimraf images && bun run copy:images && npm run generate:animations && npm run generate:images
scripts.build:skip: rimraf .parcel-cache && rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js production
scripts.build:test: rimraf .parcel-cache && bun run build:images && rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js test
scripts.start: bun run generate:images && cross-env NODE_ENV=development vite
